****_Batman_ (Volume 2) #2**** is an issue of the series [_Batman_ (Volume 2)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_Vol_2 "Batman Vol 2") with a cover date of [December, 2011](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2011,_December "Category:2011, December"). It was published on October 19, 2011.

## Synopsis for "Trust Fall"

[Wayne Tower](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wayne_Tower "Wayne Tower") was built in 1888 by [Alan Wayne](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Alan_Wayne_(Prime_Earth) "Alan Wayne (Prime Earth)"), the great, great grandfather of [Bruce Wayne](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_(Bruce_Wayne) "Batman (Bruce Wayne)"). It was built as a symbol to welcome all of those who enter [Gotham City](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Gotham_City "Gotham City"). For each entry point into the city, there was built a gargoyle or 'guardian,' to welcome visitors. At the top of the tower is an observation deck, surrounded by windows made with special glass which is, in effect, unbreakable. That is, except when someone like the assassin who has just attacked Bruce Wayne knows that the glass can be broken with an indirect hit. Smashing through the glass, Bruce Wayne plummets toward the street below.

Batman notices some scar tissue on the man's face and hands from which Gordon determined that they were the defensive scarring of someone who trained strong fighters. Additionally, they discover an unusual mark on the victim's right wisdom tooth: an Athenian Owl. The owl reminds the commissioner of a nursery rhyme about a rumoured underground organization called the Court of Owls. Batman states flatly that the Court of Owls is a legend.
